_meta.note: SYNTHESIZED, and it is the only synthesized file here. Four live captures across this harness's confined and read-only postures produced no session/request_permission frame at all: its sandbox permits an in-policy action silently and denies an out-of-policy one with the denial in the tool result, and the permission request carries only a MODEL-INITIATED ask to escalate past that sandbox. So this frame is written from the shape the harness's own protocol contract declares -- a one-shot allow/reject choice -- rather than from the wire. It exists because the replay corpus requires the class; it is NOT evidence that this harness asks, and the routing table says UNVERIFIED for exactly that reason.
